g.text: Per-Arm Hip BMD Change — The Target Is Arm-Graded

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: VERIFIED from c11_totalhipBMD_target_audit.csv + c11_subject_arm_map.csv. CONTROL loses 13 milli-units (10/11 lost bone, p=0.064). EXERCISE maintains (-0.001, p=0.732). Arm difference: ANOVA p=0.195, Kruskal-Wallis p=0.082 — suggestive but not significant.
